label: Overview: the headline lives here only
caption: Today's page, tidied: the one-sentence answer and the numbers sit in one card on Overview only, the control strip is gone, and a gear at the top right holds the colours.

label: Gear: colours set once
caption: The gear opens colour map (with each ramp), Reverse, scale with its one-line meaning, the "enough" count and the tool-frame note; picking inferno repaints every figure and is remembered.

label: One joint: its own picker
caption: The joint picker sits in the One joint tab's own header (and nowhere it doesn't apply); picking elbow_joint redraws the tab's figures.

label: Table: filter, group, save a view
caption: Search, split and kind chips, group by and "+ Save view": the filtered table becomes a view tab beside the built-in ones, and the split chip beside each name is named in the legend.

label: Drill in, Open in Rerun
caption: A row opens the drill drawer: its numbers, what it alone adds, its spans against the dataset's, its tool path among the others and its joints over time; Open in Rerun starts the native viewer (Esc closes).
